name: jotty
description: jotty-page is a lightweight alternative for managing your personal checklists and notes. It's extremely easy to deploy, keeps all your data on your own server and allows you to encrypt/decrypt your notes for your personal peace of mind.

ports.name: PORT
ports.description: You can change 1122 to any available port on your host system.

variables.name: NODE_ENV
variables.description: Sets the Node.js environment to production mode for optimal performance and security.

variables.name: PUID
variables.description: Process User ID that the container will run as.

variables.name: PGID
variables.description: Process Group ID that the container will run as.

variables.name: UMASK
variables.description: Sets the default file creation mask.

variables.name: HTTPS
variables.description: Enables HTTPS mode for secure connections.

variables.name: App URL
variables.description: Base URL of your jottyÂ·page instance. Required for secure session (https) and SSO. Include the https://

variables.name: Serve Public Images
variables.description: Allows public access to uploaded images via direct URLs.

variables.name: Serve Public Videos
variables.description: Allows public access to uploaded files via direct URLs.

variables.name: Serve Public Files
variables.description: Allows public access to uploaded files via direct URLs.

variables.name: Stop Check Updates
variables.description: If set to yes stops the github api call and won't give you a toast when a new update is available.

variables.name: Disable Bruteforce Protection
variables.description: Optional. Disables brute force protection for local login authentication. By default, accounts are temporarily locked after 3 failed login attempts with exponential delays (10s, 30s, 60s, etc.). Set to true to completely disable this security feature.

variables.name: Default Locale
variables.description: Optional. Sets the default language for the application (e.g., on the login page) when no user is logged in or a user hasn't set a preference.

variables.name: Enable PWA Zoom
variables.description: Optional. Enables zooming on the PWA for accessibility reasons.

variables.name: Auth Mode
variables.description: Enables OIDC (OpenID Connect) single sign-on or LDAP/Active Directory authentication. Set to 'oidc' or 'ldap'. Supersedes SSO_MODE.

variables.name: SSO Mode (legacy)
variables.description: Legacy fallback for AUTH_MODE. Kept for backward compatibility with existing setups — prefer AUTH_MODE for new installs. Leave empty if AUTH_MODE is set.

variables.name: OIDC Issuer
variables.description: URL of your OIDC provider (e.g., Authentik, Auth0, Keycloak).

variables.name: OIDC Client ID
variables.description: Client ID from your OIDC provider configuration.

variables.name: OIDC Client Secret
variables.description: Optional. Client secret for confidential OIDC client authentication.

variables.name: OIDC Client ID File
variables.description: Optional. Path to file containing the OIDC client ID. If set, takes priority over OIDC_CLIENT_ID. Useful for Docker Secrets.

variables.name: OIDC Client Secret File
variables.description: Optional. Path to file containing the OIDC client secret. If set, takes priority over OIDC_CLIENT_SECRET. Useful for Docker Secrets.

variables.name: Local Auth Fallback
variables.description: Optional. Allows both SSO and local authentication methods.

variables.name: OIDC Admin Groups
variables.description: Optional. Comma-separated list of OIDC groups that should have admin privileges.

variables.name: OIDC Admin Roles
variables.description: Optional. Comma-separated list of OIDC roles that should have admin privileges.

variables.name: OIDC User Groups
variables.description: Optional. Comma-separated list of OIDC groups allowed to access the application. If set, only users in these groups (or admins) can log in.

variables.name: OIDC User Roles
variables.description: Optional. Comma-separated list of OIDC roles allowed to access the application. If set, only users with these roles (or admins) can log in.

variables.name: OIDC Groups Scope
variables.description: Scope to request for groups. Defaults to 'groups'. Set to empty string or 'no' to disable for providers like Entra ID that don't support the groups scope.

variables.name: OIDC Logout URL
variables.description: Optional. Custom logout URL for global logout. Full URL to redirect to when logging out.

variables.name: LDAP URL
variables.description: URL of your LDAP server (e.g., ldap://ldap.example.com:389). Use ldaps:// on port 636 for TLS. Required when AUTH_MODE=ldap.

variables.name: LDAP Bind DN
variables.description: Distinguished name of the service account used to search the directory (e.g., cn=service,dc=example,dc=com). Required when AUTH_MODE=ldap.

variables.name: LDAP Bind Password
variables.description: Password of the LDAP service account. Required when AUTH_MODE=ldap (unless LDAP_BIND_PASSWORD_FILE is set).

variables.name: LDAP Bind Password File
variables.description: Optional. Path to a file containing the LDAP service account password. Takes priority over LDAP_BIND_PASSWORD. Useful for Docker Secrets.

variables.name: LDAP Base DN
variables.description: Base DN under which to search for users (e.g., ou=users,dc=example,dc=com). Required when AUTH_MODE=ldap.

variables.name: LDAP User Attribute
variables.description: Optional. The LDAP attribute matched against the submitted username. Defaults to 'uid'. Use 'sAMAccountName' for Active Directory.

variables.name: LDAP Admin Groups
variables.description: Optional. Pipe-separated list of group DNs granted admin rights on first login (e.g., cn=admins,ou=groups,dc=example,dc=com). Use '|' as separator since DNs contain commas. Requires memberof overlay on the LDAP server.

variables.name: LDAP User Groups
variables.description: Optional. Pipe-separated list of group DNs allowed to log in. Only members of these groups (or admin groups) can authenticate. Requires memberof overlay on the LDAP server.

variables.name: Node Extra CA Certs
variables.description: Optional. Path (inside the container) to a CA certificate file. Use this for LDAPS with a self-signed certificate (e.g., /app/config/ldap-ca.crt).

variables.name: Internal API URL
variables.description: Use if getting 403 errors after SSO login: Set to http://localhost:3000
